page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as evidenced by a stress-ng single-core score of 1108.29 and a Geekbench single-core score of 942.0, both placing in the bottom 25% of tested systems. Single-threaded tasks such as gzip compression and text processing also show poor to weak results. However, the 24 dedicated physical cores compensate in multi-threaded workloads, elevating multi-core performance to average levels. This is demonstrated by a stress-ng multi-core score of 17646.71 and a Passmark CPU score of 18419.6, both falling within the middle 50% of tested systems.

Memory performance remains consistent, with read-only and write bandwidth benchmarks scoring in the average tier. The instance achieves 16.93 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and 10.83 GB/sec in static web serving throughput, which are average results. Qualitatively, the ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge offers a balanced resource density for workloads that can leverage parallel processing but do not require high single-thread performance or local SSD storage. It is suitable for multi-threaded applications, software compilation, static web serving, and database operations that fit within its 96.0 GB memory footprint.
